visual_verification.finding: Arrest narrative clearly prints Saturday the 18th of the month. Adjacent arrival chronology and title August1835 conflict with the earlier edition and histories giving August8. No exact date selected.

custody_finding: Arrest by city officer, prolonged guarded committee hearing, corporal punishment then lodging with friends. Do not interpret departure next morning as documented prison release or create jail admission.
follow_up: Contemporary Nashville newspaper issue and Dresser manuscript, if available. Existing biography preserved.
